official.explanation: The chest X-ray findings in Figures 1a and 1b show a well-defined mass in the postero-lateral-superior region of the right hemithorax. The mass forms obtuse angles with the superior wall and acute angles with the inferior wall, which is characteristic of an extrapulmonary origin such as a pleural-based tumor. This mass's presentation, along with the patient's history of productive cough and smoking, suggests a pleural-based tumor.
